scenario.ROZKLAD_BAZOWY.name: Koleje Śląskie base timetable
scenario.ROZKLAD_BAZOWY.description: Full fleet based on GTFS + PKP PLK data: 52 regional, intercity and freight trains entering the entire network in waves.
scenario.ROZKLAD_SZCZYT_GOP.name: GOP morning peak
scenario.ROZKLAD_SZCZYT_GOP.description: Dense regional traffic around Katowice: short metropolitan services every few dozen seconds, mainly through the Katowice hub.
scenario.ROZKLAD_EKSPRESY.name: Long-distance expresses
scenario.ROZKLAD_EKSPRESY.description: Only fast PKP Intercity services — the network is nearly empty, while trains run at 160 km/h between major hubs.
scenario.ROZKLAD_TOWAROWY.name: Freight corridor
scenario.ROZKLAD_TOWAROWY.description: Heavy freight trains on coal and transit corridors — slow (80 km/h), long and difficult to overtake.
scenario.ROZKLAD_BESKIDY.name: Beskids and the south
scenario.ROZKLAD_BESKIDY.description: Tourist traffic heading south to Żywiec, Wisła, Zwardoń and Cieszyn, with one additional InterCity service to Bielsko.

landing.features.network.copy: A complete view of traffic and infrastructure status in a single, clear map.
landing.features.incidents.title: Fast Reaction
landing.features.incidents.copy: Incidents reach the operator instantly, complete with context.
landing.features.timetable.title: Timetables
landing.features.timetable.copy: Schedules and simulation show what is happening now and what comes next.
landing.features.scenarios.title: Scenarios

landing.faq.heading: FAQ
landing.faq.q1.question: What is Wagone?
landing.faq.q1.answer: Wagone is an advanced dispatcher platform enabling real-time monitoring and oversight of railway traffic.
landing.faq.q2.question: How do simulation and scenario modes work?
landing.faq.q2.answer: The system allows operators to safely test and implement traffic changes in a simulated environment before deploying them to the live railway network.
landing.faq.q3.question: Do I need an account to try the system?
landing.faq.q3.answer: No. You can click 'Enter as guest' to instantly access the system preview in demo mode.
landing.faq.q4.question: What external systems does the platform integrate with?
landing.faq.q4.answer: The platform processes data from infrastructure sensors, traffic control systems (interlockings), and timetable databases.
